info.title: HostAfricaApi
info.description:
HostAfrica’s Public API provides reliable, programmatic control over VPS services with a broad set of industry-standard API developer tools. 
As well as a RESTful API we provide a CLI and SDKs for a variety of languages as automation building blocks and a streamable MCP server for agent-driven, context-aware automation.

## Authentication
Authentication is token-based and all endpoints require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your-token>
```


API base URL is https://api.hostafrica.com/

## Token generation
You can obtain a token for the API by logging into the HostAfrica Client Area page at https://panel.hostafrica.com/login with your HostAfrica account.
It can be configured in the API settings section of the Client Area.
The token will have the same privileges as the owning client. You can also rotate or revoke a token at any time in the same section of the Client Area.

## Rate Limiting
The number of requests to the API per time period is limited. If you exceed this limit you will receive a `429 Too Many Requests` error.
Our provided SDKs and CLI will automatically retry certain requests and these settings can be overridden.
Your IP address may get temporarily blocked if you exceed the rate limit too often.

## Error Handling
Standard HTTP status code responses are returned for requests and the JSON response body contains human-readable messages for both successful and failed requests. 

## Developer Tools
We provide repositories with SDKs and code examples for a variety of languages, a CLI and a streamble MCP server.
- CLI: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-cli
- Node/TypeScript: https://github.com/hostafrica-dev/ha-sdk-typescript
- Python: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-python
- Go: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-go
- PHP: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-php
- Java: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-java (coming soon)
- C#: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-csharp (coming soon)
- Ruby: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-ruby (coming soon)
- Rust: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-rust (coming soon)
- Postman collection: https://api.hostafrica.com/docs/hostafrica-api.postman-collection.json

## MCP Server
We provide a streamable MCP server that can be used to interact with the API. We provide two endpoints.
The first endpoint is https://api.hostafrica.com/mcp and it uses the same authentication mechanism as the API.
This endpoint is suitable for use with MCP clients that support the Bearer token authentication mechanism.
The second endpoint is https://mcp.hostafrica.com/mcp which is an OAuth 2.0 endpoint.
It is compliant with OAuth-compliant MCP clients including https://claude.ai (web) and Claude desktop.
When using the OAuth 2.0 endpoint, you will be asked to authenticate with your HostAfrica API token.

## Changelog
We will provide a changelog for the API with each major release.





### Support and Feedback
For questions, bugs and feature requests specifically related to the API please create an issue[link] or discussion[link] on the repository.

For general support and feedback, please contact us at support@hostafrica.com.

post.description: Retrieves the VPS username and root password without exposing plaintext over the API. Send a PEM-encoded RSA 4096-bit public key; the API encrypts the password with RSA-OAEP (SHA-256), and returns base64 ciphertext plus encryption metadata. Never send the private key. Invalid or non-4096-bit keys return HTTP 422 ValidationError. Generate a key with: openssl genrsa -out private.pem 4096 && openssl rsa -in private.pem -pubout -out public.pem. Decrypt with: echo CIPHERTEXT | base64 -d | openssl pkeyutl -decrypt -inkey private.pem -pkeyopt rsa_padding_mode:oaep -pkeyopt rsa_oaep_md:sha256 -pkeyopt rsa_mgf1_md:sha256 (macOS: base64 -D).

DnsRecordInfo.description:
A DNS record within a zone.

Record values are normalized to a flat `content` string. Structured record types use
additional top-level fields; the proxy maps these to upstream `data` / `rdata_raw` shapes:

- **A / AAAA**: `content` is the IP address (`data.address`).
- **CNAME**: `content` is the target hostname (`data.cname`).
- **TXT**: `content` is the text value (`data.txtdata`).
- **NS**: `content` is the nameserver hostname (`data.nsdname`).
- **MX**: `content` is the mail exchange hostname; `priority` is the MX preference
  (`data.exchange`, `data.preference`).
- **SRV**: `content` is the target hostname; `priority`, `weight`, and `port` are the
  SRV parameters (`data.target`, `data.priority`, `data.weight`, `data.port`).

When upstream returns structured `rdata_raw` without a string `rdata` value, `content`
and the type-specific fields are derived from `rdata_raw`.

type.description: Record type (e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV)

content.description: Primary record value: IP address (A/AAAA), hostname (CNAME/NS/MX/SRV), or text (TXT)

priority.description: MX preference when type is MX; SRV priority when type is SRV

weight.description: SRV weight when type is SRV

port.description: SRV port when type is SRV

records.description: Updated DNS records when returned by upstream

DnsRecordMutationRecord.description:
DNS record fields for add, edit, or delete via DNSManager.

See `DnsRecordInfo` for how `content` and structured fields map to upstream record data.
Delete requires only `id`, `name`, and `type`.

id.description: Record line/id from get-dns-zone-details; required for edit and delete

name.description: Record host/name (e.g. @, www, mail); required for add

type.description: Record type (e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV); required for add

content.description: Primary record value; required for add and edit. Meaning depends on type — see DnsRecordInfo

ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds; defaults to 3600 on add when omitted

priority.description: MX preference when type is MX; SRV priority when type is SRV

weight.description: SRV weight when type is SRV

port.description: SRV port when type is SRV; required for add and edit when type is SRV

tags.name: Backups

tags.name: Monitoring
tags.description: Configure notification triggers on resource metrics such as CPU, memory, and disk usage to receive alerts when thresholds are breached.
